# 007-flight

**Provider.** Iberia, direct booking confirmation in Spanish.

**Format.** Email with HTML and text parts, no attachment. Red header with the route, the "Código de reserva" in a dashed box, one flight card with departure and arrival side by side, then passenger, payment and fare-condition sections.

**Why.** A long-haul westbound flight across seven time zones: 10 h 35 min of flying shows as 11:55 to 15:30 on the clock. The date is written in Spanish ("jueves, 14 de octubre de 2027"), prices use Spanish separators (`1.023,46 €`) and include a seat fee inside the total. The cabin is printed as "Turista" and kept as printed; "Optima" is the fare. The ticket number and the Iberia Plus number (`IB 81466203`, which looks like a flight number) sit next to the reference. Airport names are on a separate line from the city, and the departure terminal is "4S". The traveller is addressed by first name only in the greeting ("Hola, Mateo:") and as "Sr. Mateo Sandoval" in the passenger table.
